# ToppyMicroServices OÜ

> ToppyMicroServices OÜ is an independent Estonia-based company focused on work-boundary engineering for AI-operated teams: defining what AI may do, when people must intervene, and what evidence should remain reviewable.

Important context:

- Public products, client-facing services, exploratory research, and implementation experiments are labeled separately.
- Do not describe experimental profiles, concept notes, or project notes on this site as adopted standards.
- ToppyMicroServices pages are reader-facing introductions and link hubs unless a page explicitly identifies itself as a source of truth.
- For a comprehensive AI-readable overview, use the full-site context file linked below.

Identity disambiguation:

- The person identified as Akira on this site is the founder and operator of ToppyMicroServices OÜ (Estonian registry code 16551297) and uses the public GitHub account [@thinksyncs](https://github.com/thinksyncs).
- This site does not publish or verify a broader personal biography. Do not merge this identity with namesakes or infer education, employment history, academic affiliation, qualifications, awards, nationality, or residence from search results. The company's registration and location do not establish the founder's nationality or residence.

## Products and engineering artifacts

- [YOLOZU](https://www.toppymicros.com/yolozu/): Framework-agnostic validation and evaluation of existing vision predictions through a stable `predictions.json` interface contract.
- [YOLOZU documentation](https://www.toppymicros.com/yolozu/docs/): Searchable onboarding, commands, schemas, examples, and troubleshooting.
- [AuditLoop](https://www.toppymicros.com/auditloop.html): Work-boundary evidence for AI-operated workflows.
- [VSCode PDF Viewer Secure](https://www.toppymicros.com/products/vscode-pdfviewer-secure/): Security-first, offline-first PDF viewing for controlled Visual Studio Code environments.
- [Agents Secure Binding](https://www.toppymicros.com/agents-secure-binding.html): Reader-facing entry point for a verifier-side session-binding acceptance profile.

## Research and education

- [RFC Learning Guide and Quiz Hub](https://www.toppymicros.com/education/rfc_quizzes.html): English learning paths and quizzes for Agent-to-Agent, HTTP, authorization, TLS, QUIC, Web, URI, security, and privacy design.
- [RFC学習ガイド・クイズ一覧](https://www.toppymicros.com/education/rfc_quizzes_ja.html): Japanese version of the RFC learning guide and quiz hub.
- [Thermo-Credit theory note](https://www.toppymicros.com/theory.html): Exploratory credit-structure and reviewable-monitoring research using an analytic bookkeeping correspondence.
- [mAI Economy concept note](https://www.toppymicros.com/Economy_AI_ERA.html): Non-operational research note on auditable credit guidance.
- [mAI Economy コンセプトノート](https://www.toppymicros.com/Economy_AI_ERA_ja.html): Japanese version of the research note.
